title: Fiesta Fronteriza brings live music and spoken word to downtown Laredo on Nov. 5
excerpt: Fiesta Fronteriza takes place Thursday, Nov. 5, at 7 p.m. at Los Olvidados, 309 Flores Ave. in downtown Laredo, with live music, spoken word and local borderland creativity, according to the Laredo Morning Times.
content:
Fiesta Fronteriza will bring a borderland celebration to downtown Laredo on Thursday, Nov. 5, 2026, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The event will take place at 7 p.m. at Los Olvidados, located at 309 Flores Ave., which will serve as the hub for the celebration, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Fiesta Fronteriza will feature live music, spoken word and local borderland creativity, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The Rio Grande International Study Center is bringing Fiesta Fronteriza to downtown Laredo in partnership with COMPARTE Laredo and other local organizations and businesses, according to the Laredo Morning Times.
